profile.summary: Heart in Balance is a nonprofit counseling and training center in Oakland, California. It offers short- and long-term therapy for individuals, couples, families, children and teens, with affordable and sliding scale fees. It also trains pre-licensed therapists and runs a school-based program that provides mental health services to students at Bay Area schools.

Summary, address, website, EIN and org type are supported by the cited pages; the summary is neutral.
